text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, as 
Cesario and I walked down a bustling 
street—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that cake shop...! Thank goodness, the 
event is still going on!
choice_data_list: What's an event?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I got carried away all on my own. 
Trainer, do you know what a fève is?
choice_data_list: イベントって？

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"They're tiny figurines about the size of 
broad beans. There are all kinds, like 
cakes, adorable animals, moons, princes, 
and so on..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Collecting them has been a little hobby of 
mine ever since I was little. I even 
display them on the desk in my room.

Cesario beams with a radiant smile. If she 
loves it that much, maybe I should buy 
something to decorate the Trainer's office 
with.
choice_data_list: Can you buy a fève at that shop?
Can you buy a fève at that shop?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Umm... To be precise, it's more like 'you 
can get it if you're lucky', I suppose.
choice_data_list: あの店でフェーヴが買えるのか？
あの店でフェーヴが買えるの？
choice_data_list_en: Can you buy fèves at that shop?
Can you buy fèves at that shop?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
They sell fèves at variety stores, but 
originally, it's something that comes out 
of a cake called galette des rois.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When the family gathers at New Year's, 
everyone eats a cake with a fève inside, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It is said that whoever finds the fève 
will enjoy a year of good fortune, acting 
as a form of divination."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That shop is offering cakes with fèves 
inside for a limited time.
choice_data_list: Then shall we test our luck together!
Then wanna test our luck together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wah, are you sure!? Thank you, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: それなら、一緒に運試ししようか！
それなら、一緒に運試ししよっか！
choice_data_list_en: In that case, let's test our luck together!
In that case, shall we test our luck together!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here are your two 
Galettes des Rois.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wah...! It's finally time♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Since the cake is sliced into sixths, 
the odds of finding the fève are also one 
in six.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now, let us cut the cake!
choice_data_list: Take thaaat...!

text_block_list.text: (Clack)
choice_data_list: それっ……！

text_block_list.text:
The tip of the knife hits something hard. 
Holding back the urge to scream right then 
and there, I slice it open to find a 
broad-bean-sized bear rolling out.
choice_data_list: I-I-It appeared!? It's here, Cesario!!
I-I-It appeared!? It's here, Cesario!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Fufu! You're getting way too 
excited, Trainer.
choice_data_list: でで、出た！？出たぞ、シーザリオ！！
でで、出た！？出たよ、シーザリオ！！
choice_data_list_en: I-I-It's here?! It showed up, Cesario!!
I-I-It's here?! It's really here, Cesario!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, my cake was completely 
empty. Miracles really don't happen that 
easily, do they?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer, you are the king for 
today. Congratulations♪

What does she mean by 'king'? As I tilted 
my head in confusion, Cesario clapped her 
hands and said, 'Oh, that reminds me, I 
forgot to mention.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Besides telling your fortune for the year, 
finding the fève also means deciding the 
king of the day—in other words, the star 
of the show.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The King may issue orders to anyone who 
did not get a fève.
choice_data_list: Can the order be... literally anything...?
Can the order be... literally anything...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If it's my Trainer, I know they 
wouldn't give me an order that would 
trouble me.
choice_data_list: 命令って、なんでもいいのか……？
命令って、なんでもいいの……？
choice_data_list_en: An order... Can it really be anything...?
An order... Can it really be anything...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now, your majesty, your command!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Please let me know whatever you need.
choice_data_list:
In that case, I'd love it if you made me 
some sweets next time.
Then, let's go watch a comedy together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sweets... Yes, gladly. I shall prepare 
something easy to eat that can accompany 
your research.
choice_data_list: それなら、今度甘い物を作ってほしいな
じゃあ、一緒に喜劇を観にいこう！
choice_data_list_en: In that case, I'd love it if you made some sweets for me sometime.
Then let's go see a comedy together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just for reference, could you tell me your 
favorites, Trainer? I'd love to gift you 
something you enjoy.

Asked by Cesario, I told her my taste in 
sweets. She seemed to get a clear idea, 
and told me to look forward to it in the 
coming days.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you really sure I can have this 
fève? Even though you're the one who found 
it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A comedy...? That's just my own hobby, you 
know. Are you sure you want to give an 
order like that?
choice_data_list: もちろん。コレクションに加えて
choice_data_list_en: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That sounds just like you, Trainer. 
Have you decided on a play yet? If you'd 
like, I can recommend some theater troupes 
to you.
choice_data_list: 一緒に観たほうが楽しそうだから
choice_data_list_en: Because it seemed more fun to watch it together.

text_block_list.text:
We gather around the smartphone and 
discuss which play to see. Tickets were 
still available for the show we wanted, so 
we booked them on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you really sure I can have this 
fève? Even though you're the one who found 
it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'll take you up on that 
offer.
choice_data_list: もちろん。コレクションに加えて
choice_data_list_en: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely little bear♪ Center 
stage on my desk is yours for a while.

Seeing how she stroked its head with her 
fingertips, I felt truly glad I gave it to 
her. She really does seem to love fèves.
choice_data_list: So why'd you start collecting fèves?
Why did you start collecting fèves?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's no grand reason for it. I just saw 
it in a little variety store, wanted it so 
badly, and begged my parents for it—
choice_data_list: フェーヴ集めはどうして始めたんだ？
フェーヴ集めはどうして始めたの？
choice_data_list_en: Why did you start collecting fèves?
Why did you start collecting fèves?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
But it'd be lonely with just one, so I 
saved up my allowance to gather more 
friends...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, I had gathered quite a 
collection. Lately, I've been hooked on 
arranging them to reenact my favorite 
comedies."
choice_data_list:
That sort of thing is surprisingly fun, 
huh!

That sort of thing is surprisingly fun, 
isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, can you tell? It's true. Just the 
other day, I got completely absorbed in it 
too...
choice_data_list: そういうのって地味に楽しいよな！
そういうのって地味に楽しいよね！
choice_data_list_en: Stuff like that is low-key fun, isn't it!
Stuff like that is low-key fun, isn't it!

text_block_list.text:
Cesario talked on and on without stopping, 
and we had a wonderful time until we got 
back to the academy.
